title: Snowy Hub | Silent Aim, Super Speed, Tracers Inf Ammo & More
features:
Silent Aim – Automatically redirects shots toward targets within the selected FOV.

FOV Circle – Displays the active aim-assistance area.

Hit Part – Selects the body part targeted by Silent Aim.

FOV Radius – Adjusts the size of the aim-assistance area.

FOV Color – Customizes the FOV circle color.

Speed Hack – Overrides the default movement speed.

Walk Speed – Adjusts movement speed up to 250.

Auto Jump (Bhop) – Automatically jumps when touching the ground.

Master ESP – Enables or disables all player ESP features.

Box ESP – Displays boxes around players.

Name Tags – Displays player names above characters.

Health Bars – Shows players' current health.

Distance ESP – Displays the distance to other players.

Tracers – Draws lines toward other players.

Max Distance – Controls the maximum ESP detection range.

Custom Colors – Customizes ESP box, tracer, and name colors.

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the interface.

Rejoin Server – Rejoins the current server.

Hide Interface – Hides the menu while keeping enabled features active.

Auto-Save Config – Automatically saves settings for future sessions.
